Name: Run-Time Environment for end-users
Description: Fork of Apache TVM 0.18.0 that adds the RISCV2TA deployment target: a 64-bit RISC-V Linux host controlling a VTA-derived tensor accelerator on an AMD/Xilinx VCU128 FPGA. The integration covers host code generation, the VTA compiler stack, RPC execution, AutoTVM tuning, target runtime/driver support, and the associated VTA hardware fork.
